detail.name: Claret's Namecard
detail.desc: Get by unlocking Claret's Mindscape: Oath Written in Frosting
detail.desc2:
A namecard featuring the master of Flint Workshop.
The workshop's emblem and Claret's name are engraved against a rustic backdrop, with intricate, elaborate patterns that are easily mistaken for Porcelloy craftsmanship. Claret, however, clearly has no interest in wasting Porcelloy on such trivial decoration.
